mechanism: Rc::inc_strong's own core::intrinsics::unlikely is a no-op on rustc 1.79-dev, so its overflow-trap edge gets BPI's unreachable weight (~1e-6). Copying inc_strong into an inline(always) helper whose trap test carries llvm.expect / llvm.expect.with.probability makes every later block slightly colder; StackSlotColoring sorts spill slots by frequency-weighted use, so near-tied clone-run spill slots renumber toward the original. No instruction or register moves in the landed cases.
rules: Pointer-held accounts (Interface, Program, Signer, UncheckedAccount, manual literals) take the derive literal codegen-neutrally; an inline AccountInfo field rewritten as a literal changes codegen (cc_plain 0.60117 @27408), but an inline(always) &AccountInfo helper shaped like the derived Clone (aiclone_r) is byte-identical (ccr_plain sha edd56f45) and can carry the weighted clone.

The M response to the trap probability is chaotic at the 1% scale; screen with the exact expect.with.probability weights ceil(p*(2^31-2)+1) on the IR oracle of the CURRENT main, then build; source builds matched the oracle exactly in every realizable case.
lamports and data traps of the same clone are equivalent; stacking a second 1:2000 trap on #3950 loses.
